data_fields.name: node_tier
data_fields.donor_constant: tier (no default in Drill.java; set per block)

best_idea: A timed yield should be the majority resource under the node (ties broken by a fixed priority, then a stable id), with progress that carries its remainder into whole items, and a warmup that ramps up while running and decays while blocked.
decision_why: The majority-with-fixed-tie-break choice and remainder carry suit zone gathering nodes if they are added; kill loot is a separate roll and is unchanged; the liquid boost and unclamped emit are rejected.
acceptance: A server test: a node over 3 tiles of ore A (hardness 1) and 1 tile of ore B yields only ore A; over a fixed interval it yields floor(progress / delay) whole items and keeps the remainder; when its held items reach capacity its progress stops and its warmup decays.
